test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/423a827562f56de405698e6ed4d7309c24f99bfa4936fd7fcb6585735fd09223.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) All the figures shifted in one place clockwise. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7efbf1c9b16381dddb7ab092e7e98e1a563a727e53b7738ec885961c216beed4.png] 

2) All the figures shifted in two places clockwise. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86511ec1a64895ed10ea1ec4c40936ef0df50c4a23ab19c1469ff1348c9e19f9.png] 

3) All the figures shifted in three places clockwise. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/068535a954362e7ae58466ccc788c7e74fe59dc7a272cedd5579eeccbd3eb87c.png] 

4) All the figures shifted in four places clockwise, which is the same place. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86a06495388460f86d02664246fe05426b5bb8ee9a1d77b7d39972e7583fc4ef.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 4”
